name: netmedex-hybrid-hidden-meaning-development-v2
purpose: Improve Hybrid RAG so graph paths reveal evidence-grounded, non-obvious biomedical meaning beyond text-only RAG.
claim_boundary: Development analysis only; it cannot establish independent superiority because the source questions have prior-system exposure.

paid_pilot_selection.rule: Graph-oriented mechanism/hypothesis questions with at least one cached path after deterministic alias-aware proxy gating.

cost_control.stage_2: generate paired answers only for questions with at least one Tier A path
cost_control.stage_3: run blinded judges only for traceable candidate claims
